jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Posting Type

Hybrid/Remote

Job Overview

WHO WE ARE

Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial.

The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we’re deeply committed to expanding access to technology for academic institutions through Relativity Academic and supporting pro bono legal work through Justice for Change.

What We Do

At Relativity, engineers don’t just write code. They build the systems that power AI-driven workflows at massive scale, enabling customers to uncover insights and act on complex data with confidence.

aiR Services Team

The aiR Services team builds the shared backend platform that powers Relativity’s generative AI products. These systems enable secure and scalable access to foundation models across the aiR Suite while handling challenges such as limited model capacity, global data privacy requirements, and fair usage across products and customers. The team works on high-throughput, distributed systems that route AI traffic across regions and providers, protect downstream services from reliability risks, and optimize cost and performance at scale.

If you’re excited about building platforms that power an entire product suite, working with generative AI systems in production, and solving distributed systems challenges at global scale, this is a high-impact team to join.

Job Description And Requirements

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Software Engineer, you will build and operate backend services that power Relativity’s generative AI platform, aiR. You will work at the intersection of distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and applied AI, helping to deliver reliable, scalable systems that sit on the critical path of AI-powered workflows.

This role reports to the Manager of Software Engineering and provides the opportunity to work on multi-region, multi-cloud systems that handle large-scale AI traffic and complex orchestration challenges.

What You’ll Do

Design and build performant, scalable, and secure backend services with a strong focus on quality, not just meeting requirements
Collaborate with a software development team to deliver high-quality, reliable systems that operate at massive scale
Develop and maintain systems that support high-throughput AI workloads, including asynchronous job orchestration and distributed processing
Write comprehensive unit and integration tests supported by static analysis and thoughtful test strategy development
Contribute to improving engineering processes by recommending enhancements to tools, workflows, and practices
Participate in pair programming to improve software quality and share design and implementation knowledge
Contribute to building systems that route and manage AI traffic efficiently while maintaining reliability and fairness across workloads

Required

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Experience building backend services using languages such as C#, Python, or similar
Understanding of software engineering disciplines and the ability to work across multiple layers of the application stack
Strong foundational knowledge of distributed systems, scalability, and backend service design

Preferred

Understanding of DevOps principles and experience with tools such as GitHub Actions
Experience working with large language model (LLM) APIs or generative AI systems
Experience designing and building scalable systems in Azure or other cloud platforms
Experience with Kubernetes, serverless technologies, and cloud-native architectures
Familiarity with domain-driven design and event-driven architecture
Experience with AI-driven development practices or AI-assisted coding tools
Awareness of emerging technology trends and their practical application in engineering

WHY WE COULD BE A GREAT FIT

Impactful AI Platform

Build foundational systems that power Relativity’s generative AI capabilities and enable products across the aiR Suite.

Distributed Systems at Scale

Work on high-throughput, multi-region services that handle large volumes of AI traffic reliably and efficiently.

Cutting-Edge Technology

Gain hands-on experience with generative AI systems, cloud-native infrastructure, and modern distributed architectures.

Growth Opportunity

Develop deep expertise in backend systems, cloud platforms, and AI-driven services while working on highly visible, impactful projects.

Collaborative Culture

Work with a team that values strong engineering fundamentals, shared ownership, and continuous learning.

Compensation And Benefits

Competitive salary, health and retirement programs, wellness resources, discretionary time off (DTO), parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers, company-wide breaks, home office stipend, and an equity program.

Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.

This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long-term incentives.

The expected salary range for this role is between following values:

$79,000 and $119,000

The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position.

Required Skills

Automation, Documentations, Engineering Design, Problem Solving, Process Improvements, Project Management, Quality Assurance (QA), Research and Development, System Integration, Troubleshooting

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Helsing develops artificial intelligence enabled capabilities to protect and defend democracies. We are growing our US operations, cultivating an ambitious and committed team of mission driven professionals to apply their skills to solve challenging problems.

The role

As a Systems Engineer, you will contribute to the development of a next generation loitering munition system for the U.S. Army. Working as part of a multidisciplinary engineering team, you will support the development, integration and verification of complex defense systems, helping translate customer requirements into practical engineering solutions.

You will work alongside Senior and Lead Systems Engineers, supporting activities across the systems engineering lifecycle, including requirements development, system documentation, interface management, integration and test.

Your work will span the All Up Round (AUR), Fire Control System (FCS), and their integration into the Infantry Brigade Combat Team (IBCT) force structure. You will collaborate with hardware, software, mechanical, electrical and safety engineering teams to ensure individual components and subsystems work together as part of a fully integrated system.

This is an opportunity for an engineer with a strong technical foundation and an interest in complex defense systems to take ownership of meaningful engineering deliverables, develop their systems engineering expertise and contribute directly to the delivery of operational military capability.

The day-to-day

Support the development, documentation and management of system and subsystem requirements.
Assist with translating customer and stakeholder needs into clear, measurable and verifiable engineering requirements.
Maintain requirements traceability, ensuring requirements are appropriately allocated to subsystems and linked to verification activities.
Develop and maintain systems engineering documentation, including specifications, interface documentation, engineering reports and verification records.
Support system architecture development and interface definition across hardware, software and mechanical subsystems.
Work with multidisciplinary engineering teams to support system integration and resolve technical issues.
Assist with integration, verification and validation activities to demonstrate system compliance against defined requirements.
Support the preparation and execution of system level testing, including laboratory integration and hardware-in-the-loop activities.
Analyse test results, document findings and support the investigation and resolution of engineering issues.
Participate in technical design reviews, including System Requirements Review (SRR), Preliminary Design Review (PDR) and Critical Design Review (CDR).
Support configuration management, technical baseline documentation and engineering change processes.
Work with Senior and Lead Systems Engineers to identify technical risks, dependencies and potential design improvements.
Support the development of engineering solutions that meet system safety, reliability, maintainability and performance requirements.

You should apply if you

Hold a university degree in systems engineering, aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, computer science or a related technical discipline.
Have approximately 3–5 years of engineering experience, ideally within systems engineering, defense, aerospace, advanced manufacturing or complex hardware development.
Have a foundational understanding of systems engineering principles and the systems development lifecycle.
Have experience or exposure to requirements development, technical documentation, system specifications or engineering change management.
Understand the importance of requirements traceability, interface management and configuration control.
Have an interest in system integration, verification and validation, and the testing of complex engineering systems.
Are comfortable working across multidisciplinary engineering teams and communicating technical information clearly.
Demonstrate strong analytical and problem solving skills, with the ability to investigate technical issues and work towards practical solutions.
Are organised, detail oriented and able to manage multiple engineering tasks.
Are motivated to take ownership of engineering deliverables and develop your technical capabilities within a growing engineering organisation.
Are a U.S. citizen and able to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance.
Are willing to travel to government test facilities and vendor or partner sites as required.

Nice to have

Previous experience supporting defense, aerospace, military platform, munition or unmanned aircraft development programmes.
Familiarity with requirements management and systems engineering tools.
Exposure to Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), SysML or Cameo MagicDraw.
Familiarity with MIL-HDBK-516C, MIL-STD-882E, SAE ARP-4754A, ARP-4761, DO-178C or DO-254.
Exposure to system integration, hardware in the loop testing or verification and validation campaigns.
Understanding of system safety, reliability and airworthiness principles.
Familiarity with Army tactical networks, ATAK, UVC standards or Common Control concepts for uncrewed systems.
Exposure to configuration management and technical baseline control.
Able to obtain and hold a U.S. Top Secret security clearance.

Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields

Helsing's work is important. You'll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns.

The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world.

Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation. The defense industry is entering an exciting phase of technological development, and Helsing is part of that progress.

We actively encourage healthy, proactive and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted and encouraged to practice responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity.

What We Offer

A focus on outcomes, not time tracking.
A generous compensation and benefits package (in addition to base salary) that includes, but may not be limited to, insurance coverage (medical and travel), flexible paid time off, paid holidays, and remote and/or hybrid work available depending on position.
Opportunities to develop your systems engineering expertise and progress toward more senior technical responsibilities within Helsing's U.S. engineering organization.

The base salary offered to the successful candidate will be determined by a variety of factors including relevant experience, qualifications, education, skill level, interview performance and the level and scope of the position.

Helsing is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We will consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetics or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

Most engineering roles place you either close to the product or close to the customer. This role gives you both.

You'll build the parts of Lovable that Enterprise level companies depend on: security, governance, admin controls, integrations with their existing systems, and performance at scale.

Up to 40% of your time you’ll be forward deployed, working directly with enterprise customers on their hardest technical problems. 8+ years experience building, shipping and maintaining production-grade software

Job Overview

WHO WE ARE

Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial.

The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we’re deeply committed to expanding access to technology for academic institutions through Relativity Academic and supporting pro bono legal work through Justice for Change.

What We Do

At Relativity, engineers don’t just write code. They build the systems that power AI-driven workflows at massive scale, enabling customers to uncover insights and act on complex data with confidence.

aiR Services Team

The aiR Services team builds the shared backend platform that powers Relativity’s generative AI products. These systems enable secure and scalable access to foundation models across the aiR Suite while handling challenges such as limited model capacity, global data privacy requirements, and fair usage across products and customers. The team works on high-throughput, distributed systems that route AI traffic across regions and providers, protect downstream services from reliability risks, and optimize cost and performance at scale.

If you’re excited about building platforms that power an entire product suite, working with generative AI systems in production, and solving distributed systems challenges at global scale, this is a high-impact team to join.

Job Description And Requirements

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Software Engineer, you will build and operate backend services that power Relativity’s generative AI platform, aiR. You will work at the intersection of distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and applied AI, helping to deliver reliable, scalable systems that sit on the critical path of AI-powered workflows.

This role reports to the Manager of Software Engineering and provides the opportunity to work on multi-region, multi-cloud systems that handle large-scale AI traffic and complex orchestration challenges.

What You’ll Do

Design and build performant, scalable, and secure backend services with a strong focus on quality, not just meeting requirements
Collaborate with a software development team to deliver high-quality, reliable systems that operate at massive scale
Develop and maintain systems that support high-throughput AI workloads, including asynchronous job orchestration and distributed processing
Write comprehensive unit and integration tests supported by static analysis and thoughtful test strategy development
Contribute to improving engineering processes by recommending enhancements to tools, workflows, and practices
Participate in pair programming to improve software quality and share design and implementation knowledge
Contribute to building systems that route and manage AI traffic efficiently while maintaining reliability and fairness across workloads

Required

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Experience building backend services using languages such as C#, Python, or similar
Understanding of software engineering disciplines and the ability to work across multiple layers of the application stack
Strong foundational knowledge of distributed systems, scalability, and backend service design

Preferred

Understanding of DevOps principles and experience with tools such as GitHub Actions
Experience working with large language model (LLM) APIs or generative AI systems
Experience designing and building scalable systems in Azure or other cloud platforms
Experience with Kubernetes, serverless technologies, and cloud-native architectures
Familiarity with domain-driven design and event-driven architecture
Experience with AI-driven development practices or AI-assisted coding tools
Awareness of emerging technology trends and their practical application in engineering

WHY WE COULD BE A GREAT FIT

Impactful AI Platform

Build foundational systems that power Relativity’s generative AI capabilities and enable products across the aiR Suite.

Distributed Systems at Scale

Work on high-throughput, multi-region services that handle large volumes of AI traffic reliably and efficiently.

Cutting-Edge Technology

Gain hands-on experience with generative AI systems, cloud-native infrastructure, and modern distributed architectures.

Growth Opportunity

Develop deep expertise in backend systems, cloud platforms, and AI-driven services while working on highly visible, impactful projects.

Collaborative Culture

Work with a team that values strong engineering fundamentals, shared ownership, and continuous learning.

Competitive salary, health and retirement programs, wellness resources, discretionary time off (DTO), parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers, company-wide breaks, home office stipend, and an equity program.

Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.

This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long-term incentives.

$79,000 and $119,000

Who We Are

Helsing develops artificial intelligence enabled capabilities to protect and defend democracies. We are growing our US operations, cultivating an ambitious and committed team of mission driven professionals to apply their skills to solve challenging problems.

The role

As a Systems Engineer, you will contribute to the development of a next generation loitering munition system for the U.S. Army. Working as part of a multidisciplinary engineering team, you will support the development, integration and verification of complex defense systems, helping translate customer requirements into practical engineering solutions.

You will work alongside Senior and Lead Systems Engineers, supporting activities across the systems engineering lifecycle, including requirements development, system documentation, interface management, integration and test.

Your work will span the All Up Round (AUR), Fire Control System (FCS), and their integration into the Infantry Brigade Combat Team (IBCT) force structure. You will collaborate with hardware, software, mechanical, electrical and safety engineering teams to ensure individual components and subsystems work together as part of a fully integrated system.

This is an opportunity for an engineer with a strong technical foundation and an interest in complex defense systems to take ownership of meaningful engineering deliverables, develop their systems engineering expertise and contribute directly to the delivery of operational military capability.

The day-to-day

Support the development, documentation and management of system and subsystem requirements.
Assist with translating customer and stakeholder needs into clear, measurable and verifiable engineering requirements.
Maintain requirements traceability, ensuring requirements are appropriately allocated to subsystems and linked to verification activities.
Develop and maintain systems engineering documentation, including specifications, interface documentation, engineering reports and verification records.
Support system architecture development and interface definition across hardware, software and mechanical subsystems.
Work with multidisciplinary engineering teams to support system integration and resolve technical issues.
Assist with integration, verification and validation activities to demonstrate system compliance against defined requirements.
Support the preparation and execution of system level testing, including laboratory integration and hardware-in-the-loop activities.
Analyse test results, document findings and support the investigation and resolution of engineering issues.
Participate in technical design reviews, including System Requirements Review (SRR), Preliminary Design Review (PDR) and Critical Design Review (CDR).
Support configuration management, technical baseline documentation and engineering change processes.
Work with Senior and Lead Systems Engineers to identify technical risks, dependencies and potential design improvements.
Support the development of engineering solutions that meet system safety, reliability, maintainability and performance requirements.

You should apply if you

Hold a university degree in systems engineering, aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, computer science or a related technical discipline.
Have approximately 3–5 years of engineering experience, ideally within systems engineering, defense, aerospace, advanced manufacturing or complex hardware development.
Have a foundational understanding of systems engineering principles and the systems development lifecycle.
Have experience or exposure to requirements development, technical documentation, system specifications or engineering change management.
Understand the importance of requirements traceability, interface management and configuration control.
Have an interest in system integration, verification and validation, and the testing of complex engineering systems.
Are comfortable working across multidisciplinary engineering teams and communicating technical information clearly.
Demonstrate strong analytical and problem solving skills, with the ability to investigate technical issues and work towards practical solutions.
Are organised, detail oriented and able to manage multiple engineering tasks.
Are motivated to take ownership of engineering deliverables and develop your technical capabilities within a growing engineering organisation.
Are a U.S. citizen and able to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance.
Are willing to travel to government test facilities and vendor or partner sites as required.

Nice to have

Previous experience supporting defense, aerospace, military platform, munition or unmanned aircraft development programmes.
Familiarity with requirements management and systems engineering tools.
Exposure to Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), SysML or Cameo MagicDraw.
Familiarity with MIL-HDBK-516C, MIL-STD-882E, SAE ARP-4754A, ARP-4761, DO-178C or DO-254.
Exposure to system integration, hardware in the loop testing or verification and validation campaigns.
Understanding of system safety, reliability and airworthiness principles.
Familiarity with Army tactical networks, ATAK, UVC standards or Common Control concepts for uncrewed systems.
Exposure to configuration management and technical baseline control.
Able to obtain and hold a U.S. Top Secret security clearance.

Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields

Helsing's work is important. You'll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns.

The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world.

Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation. The defense industry is entering an exciting phase of technological development, and Helsing is part of that progress.

We actively encourage healthy, proactive and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted and encouraged to practice responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity.

What We Offer

A focus on outcomes, not time tracking.
A generous compensation and benefits package (in addition to base salary) that includes, but may not be limited to, insurance coverage (medical and travel), flexible paid time off, paid holidays, and remote and/or hybrid work available depending on position.
Opportunities to develop your systems engineering expertise and progress toward more senior technical responsibilities within Helsing's U.S. engineering organization.

The base salary offered to the successful candidate will be determined by a variety of factors including relevant experience, qualifications, education, skill level, interview performance and the level and scope of the position.

Helsing is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We will consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetics or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

new_jobs.description:
TL;DR
– We’re looking for Staff Software Engineers to join the team and build Lovable for our Enterprise customers. Your time will be split between customer engagements and building our core product. Up to 40% of your time could be forward deployed, working directly with enterprise customers to solve their hardest technical problems. The rest you’ll spend back in the product team, building what you’ve learned in the field into the Lovable platform. It’s a unique opportunity to work on both sides of enterprise software and solve problems with AI that no one has solved before.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

About The Role

Most engineering roles place you either close to the product or close to the customer. This role gives you both.

You'll build the parts of Lovable that Enterprise level companies depend on: security, governance, admin controls, integrations with their existing systems, and performance at scale.

Up to 40% of your time you’ll be forward deployed, working directly with enterprise customers on their hardest technical problems. The rest of the time you’ll be back in the product team, building what the field showed you. The aim of every rotation is to turn what one customer needs into something every customer can use.

If you want to stay deeply hands-on, close to both real customer problems and the product that solves them, this is that role. Forward Deployed rotations may involve travel to customer sites.

What You’ll Do

Build and ship core enterprise capabilities across Lovable’s frontend, backend and AI systems, and operate them in production
Turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical designs and working production systems
Spend up-to 40% of your time forward deployed with enterprise customers, solving their hardest technical problems
Turn what you learned in the field into foundational platform improvements
Identify and codify repeatable deployment patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams.
Own projects end-to-end—from discovery and architecture through shipping and iteration
Debug complex issues across application, infrastructure, and AI-system boundaries
Shape how the Enterprise team runs its field rotations, including engineering standards, rituals, and playbooks
Contribute to core product strategy, technical decisions, and cultural foundations

What We’re Looking For

8+ years experience building, shipping and maintaining production-grade software
Strong full-stack engineering fundamentals, including robust backend (Go, Rust) development and React and TypeScript on the frontend
You have worked directly with customers, and have the product sense to tell a one-off request from something every customer needs
Strong architectural thinking and familiarity with distributed systems
Experience building for enterprise requirements such as SSO, role-based access control, audit logging, data residency or compliance
Strong architectural thinking and familiarity with distributed systems
Ability to prototype rapidly and turn successful experiments into production-quality solutions

Bonus if you’ve:

Worked on agentic AI systems or built with LLMs before
Led zero-to-one product development
Worked in a forward deployed, solutions, or partner engineering role
Worked in a founding or early startup environment

Our Tech Stack

Backend: Golang & Rust
Frontend: React, Typescript
Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, multiple LLM providers
Tooling: Github Actions, OTEL, Grafana, Terraform, and more

How We Hire

Fill out a short form and hop on a brief intro call with our recruiting team.
Complete a quick live coding exercise.
Show us how you approach problems during several technical interviews.
Show us something you’ve built that makes you proud.
